note: Derivation (08-classes.md §3h, to be written; this note is the record until then): every hobby Chrome prospect autograph of 2019 Bowman (Chrome Prospect Autograph, CPA-, 62; released Apr 17 2019 per Cardsmiths), 2019 Bowman Chrome (Chrome Prospect Autograph, CPA-, 68 lines for 66 cards; Sep 17 2019) and 2019 Bowman Draft (Chrome Autograph, CDA-, 81; Dec 3 2019) from Cardsmiths full checklists, read Oct 31 2026, matched by accent-folded player name (Jr./II/III dropped) against every Chrome prospect auto list of 2016-2018 Bowman / Bowman Chrome / Bowman Draft (2018 Bowman Chrome: Cardsmiths, its prospect autos print BCPA-, 80; the other eight lists: Cardboard Connection, CPA- / CDA-) and the earlier 2019 releases. 8 rows have an earlier auto and are false (Bohm, Singer, Mize, Madrigal - 2018 Bowman Draft CDAs; Capel - 2018 Bowman Chrome BCPA-CC; Guerrero Jr. - 2016 Bowman Chrome CPA-VG; McKenna and Agustin - their 2019 Bowman May CPA precedes the 2019 Chrome CPA); 2 held on a name-only match with a different team (Eloy Jimenez CHW vs 2017 CHC; Luis Garcia PHI vs 2018 WSH). Cross-checks: BOW20's four false rows (Rutschman, Vaughn, Bleday, Greene) are true here as 2019 Bowman Draft CDAs; Henderson CDA-GH and Rutschman CDA-AR match 08 §3c. Open before universeComplete: (1) 2019 Bowman Mega Box, 2019 Bowman Chrome Mega Box and 2019 Sapphire auto lists not read (Cardsmiths 404 for 2019 Sapphire; Cardboard Connection 404 for the Mega / Sapphire slugs tried) - a Mega- or Sapphire-only first auto would be missing (G31 / G61); (2) the 2 held rows; (3) consoles patterned; (4) priors read back to 2016 only, and the 2016-2018 lists other than 2018 Chrome are one source each (Cardboard Connection; 2016 Bowman Chrome lists 24 CPA there, lower than the other years - re-read before universeComplete); (5) insert / dual autos (Dual Bowman Prospect, Prime Chrome Signature, Stat Track, Class of 2019, Franchise Futures) are not priors under the 08 §1 working rule (G61).
